The world’s largest desalination plant by production capacity is the **Shoaiba Power and Desalination Plant** in **Saudi Arabia**.  

- **Location:** Shoaibah (Shuaiba) on the western coast of the Red Sea, near Jeddah.  
- **Capacity:** about **2,998,000 m³ (≈2.998 million cubic meters) of potable water per day** (approximately 3 million m³/day).  
- **Status:** The plant is fully operational and has held the Guinness World Record for the largest desalination facility for several years.

This figure is the most recent publicly reported capacity for the world’s largest operating desalination complex.
